protocol.py: 3 biology problems (2 warnings, 1 note).

1. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from 10 wells before it was mixed: added at line
51, drawn at line 50 and line 57
   line 51:  p300.dispense(50, target_well)
   reached through: run:62 > process_row:51
   At line 51 liquid was added to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 2 more in slot 3,
   which already held a different liquid (this line did it 10 times). At line 50 and line 57
   liquid was drawn out of them again, and the well was never mixed in between. Two liquids
   layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the tip drew is not at the
   concentration you calculated. In a dilution series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 2 more in slot 3.
   Also reached 1 other well: tube A6 in slot 2.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 51: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [9bcad7a1cbcd]

2. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from 10 wells before it was mixed: added at line
51, drawn at line 50 and line 57
   line 51:  p300.dispense(50, target_well)
   reached through: run:63 > process_row:51
   At line 51 liquid was added to wells B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8 and 2 more in slot 3,
   which already held a different liquid (this line did it 10 times). At line 50 and line 57

   Affected: wells B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, B7, B8 and 2 more in slot 3.
   Also reached 1 other well: tube A6 in slot 2.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 51: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [aba06b16d384]

3. NOTE WELL-CAPACITY: Declared more than the well holds: 2000 ul in a 1898 ul well, 3 wells
   line 50:  p300.aspirate(50, source)
   reached through: run:62 > process_row:50
   At line 50 the robot draws from tube A1 in slot 2, which the protocol declares (line 25)
   to hold 2000 ul; the well holds 1897.79 ul, and 2 more are like it. The prep sheet cannot
   be followed as written. Wells: tubes A1, A2 and A3 in slot 2.
   Affected: tubes A1, A2 and A3 in slot 2.
   Fix: Declare what the well can really hold, or use a bigger container.
   Source: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in
   microlitres
           https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Opentrons/opentrons/edge/shared-data/labware/schemas/2.json
   Source: Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container
   holds
           https://jakebeal.github.io/Publications/JETC23-LabOP.pdf
   [51344bad3928]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
